description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Cron' model class within the Opencart admin setting namespace. It provides methods to manage scheduled tasks (crons) via database operations such as add, delete, edit, and retrieve cron records.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Model class for managing CRUD operations related to scheduled crons in the database.

methods.name: addCron
methods.description: Creates a new cron record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: deleteCron
methods.description: Deletes a cron record identified by cron_id.

methods.name: deleteCronByCode
methods.description: Deletes a cron record based on its code.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the cron record identified by cron_id, primarily to modify the date_modified timestamp.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific cron entry.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Retrieves a cron record by its cron_id.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a cron record by its code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Fetches multiple cron records, with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total count of cron records.
